Messages.Author: Silmegil
Messages.Body:
After a permanent which has changed controler (for example Mylan Horseed stolen by Entrancement) is killed and moved to ash heap, which ash heap it is?

I of course know that after the game ends, true owner gets his card back. But I would say, that if I steal some ally by entrancement and it dies, it will go to my ash heap for remainder of the game.

Am I correct? Or am I missing something simple, which proves me wrong? Thank you.

czechvtes.blogspot.com/

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body: Cards will always go to the owner's ash heap

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Haze wrote:
> Cards will always go to the owner's ash heap
>
when sent to an ash heap.
Correct.

Messages.Author: Chaitan
Messages.Body:
Rulebook 1.1 section 2.

> Burn: When a card is "burned," it is placed into its owner's discard pile (the discard pile is called the "ash heap" for this reason).
>

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:

> Rulebook 1.1 section 2.

A 'yes' or 'no' would've been helpful here in addition to explanations. So, the important distinction here is between 'controller' and 'owner'? So cards are always returned to their original owners' ash heaps, not the latest controllers'?

Just to be doubly sure.
